evidence.quote: This thesis examines the causal impact of generative AI tools on software developer productivity through a pilot randomized field experiment.
The experiment was conducted between July and September 2024 at a Finnish technology consulting company that specializes in software development and digital transformation services.

In my study, I map "activity" onto development speed and "performance" onto code quality, recognizing that commit counts or cycle times alone can mislead if they sacrifice maintainability or introduce defects.
Task completion time served as the efficiency measure and was recorded through participant self-reporting at the completion of each task.
Code quality assessment served as the second primary outcome and employed expert evaluation by a senior developer with over 20 years of professional software development experience.
